user_statement: Alright please commit and upload all details of the power design and parts. Make sure everything is marked as selected. Cleanup old variants not relevant anymore. Then perform a review of the task and mark it as done.

runtime_intent.description: Aim for roughly one hour per charge; half an hour is too short for the desired experience.
runtime_intent.reference_kind: approximate design intent, not a physical qualification threshold

model_basis.cell_selection_scope: Human-selected current3S3Pdesignround, not a purchased/qualified finished pack.
model_basis.geometry_scope: Nine distributedsource cellkits in exactR33native poses; no tight rectangular pack claim.

next_work: Place and mount the remaining power functions: distribution, clamp boards, converters, bulk capacitors, main/branch fuses, service/charge ports and heat-coupled resistors. Several still have only planning envelopes; do not substitute empty targets for finished hardware.

Rebuild connected cell/main/sense/NTC wiring around the changed cell poses and mounts, including strain relief, insulation, vent paths, cable exits and service slack. Old conductor geometries were withdrawn explicitly; this scene is not an electrically connected pack.

Measure printed/metal interfaces and cell/insulator tolerances; finish controlled compliant fit, PA12 rim/arm stiffness and creep, fastener specification/preload, full extraction/motion, mounted thermal behavior and physical trial.
limits: A static native-CAD candidate, not an assembled battery or fabrication release. Source can kits/PCB components use stated source envelopes; motor family includes invalid source solids.
No complete moving clearance, manufactured tolerance/preload, handle reach, wire/extraction path, print process, hot/wet creep, vent/impact, thermal or physical qualification.

639g is nine supplier maximum71gcells alone. The243.98g screen covers only density-assigned sharedcarrier/PA12geometry; it excludes circuits, wiring, most terminals/fasteners and remaining modules. Sharedcarrier is not duplicated structural mass.
Historical endurance is conditional and unchanged. No new electrical load, full-system thermal or full-to-empty result in this mounting round.

Remaining modules/hotparts/ports and rerouted connected harness remain uninstalled. Protectedhost5Vendpoint remains unresolved. Full-package goal is carried into the linked follow-up; accepted design-round closure is not package/hardware completion.

Historical sealed reports retain candidate/unselected wording from their measurement dates. This later human selection supersedes selection state only; it does not change their evidence or qualifications.
